items.title: 24.6.2 Separation of Amino Acids via Electrophoresis (electrophoresis se amino acids alag karna) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Amino acids ko aik doosre se kai tareeqon se alag kiya ja sakta hai. Aik tareeqa electrophoresis hai, jo mixture ke amino acids ko un ke charge ki basis par alag karta hai. Is mein mixture ke kuch drops (qatre) filter paper ya gel par dale jate hain jo do electrodes ke beech buffered solution (jis ka pH qaim rahe) mein rakha hota hai. Electric field lagane par amino acids apni alag alag pI values ke mutabiq alag ho jate hain. Agar amino acid ka pI solution ke pH se zyada ho to woh zyada tar positive charge wali shakal mein hota hai aur cathode (negative electrode) ki taraf chalta hai. Agar pI pH se kam ho to woh zyada tar negative shakal mein hota hai aur anode (positive electrode) ki taraf chalta hai. pI aur pH ka farq jitna zyada, amino acid utna tez chalta hai (Figure 24.2). Agar do amino acids ki pI values bohat qareeb hon (jaise glycine aur leucine), to zyada molecular weight wala aahista chalta hai, kyunke charge ko zyada mass (wazan) uthana parta hai.

blocks.alt: Peeli strip, baen negative electrode aur daen positive electrode, teen spots (dhabbe): Lysine (pI = 9.74) negative end ke qareeb, Alanine (pI = 6.02) beech mein aur Glutamic acid (pI = 3.22) positive end ke qareeb, har aik ke label se arrow.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.2: pH 6 par electrophoresis se amino acids ki separation (alag karna) (kitab ki Figure 24.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: pH 6 par: lysine ka pI (9.74) pH se zyada hai, is liye woh positive hai aur negative electrode (cathode, baen taraf) ki taraf jata hai. Alanine ka pI (6.02) pH ke qareeb hai, is liye woh taqreeban beech mein rehta hai. Glutamic acid ka pI (3.22) pH se kam hai, is liye woh negative hai aur positive electrode (anode, daen taraf) ki taraf jata hai.

Amino acids colourless (be-rang) hain, is liye paper par un ke spots (dhabbe) dekhne ke liye koi tareeqa chahiye. Ninhydrin locating agent (dhabbe dikhane wala) ke taur par use hota hai; yeh amino acids se react kar ke purple (jamni) product banata hai.

blocks.alt: Do lines mein: amino acid (NH2 wale carbon par R aur COOH) + 2 ninhydrin (benzene ring five-membered ring se juri, do C=O aur beech ke carbon par do OH), arrow ke oopar NaOH, se purple product (aisi do ring units C-N=C se juri, har aik mein do C=O) + by-products H2O, CO2 aur RCHO.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ka ninhydrin se reaction (kitab ke page 131 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ninhydrin ke do molecules aik amino acid se react karte hain. Amino acid ka nitrogen do ninhydrin hisson ko jor deta hai aur purple (jamni) product banta hai; amino acid ka baqi hissa CO₂ aur aldehyde (RCHO) ban kar alag ho jata hai, aur paani bhi nikalta hai. Isi purple rang se paper par colourless amino acids ke spots nazar aate hain.

Electrophoresis se amino acids ki bari quantity alag nahi ki ja sakti. Yeh sirf analysis (jaanch) ka tareeqa hai jis se maloom hota hai ke mixture mein kitne amino acids hain. Poore mixture ke amino acids waqai alag karne ke liye lab ke doosre tareeqe, jaise column chromatography, use hote hain.

blocks.prompt: pH 6 par lysine (pI 9.74) kis electrode ki taraf jata hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cathode (negative electrode) ki taraf: is ka pI pH se zyada hai, is liye is par kul (overall) positive charge hai.

items: pI > pH: positive, cathode ki taraf; pI < pH: negative, anode ki taraf.
Zyada farq: tez; bhari molecule: aahista.
Ninhydrin colourless spots ko purple dikhata hai.
